title: AICP DID Document
description: DID Document for the did:aicp method, conforming to W3C DID Core.

@context.description: JSON-LD context. First entry must be the W3C DID context.

id.description: The DID subject identifier using the did:aicp method.

controller.description: The DID of the entity authorized to make changes to this DID Document.

verificationMethod.description: Cryptographic public keys associated with this DID.

authentication.description: References to verification methods used for authentication.

assertionMethod.description: References to verification methods used for issuing assertions.

capabilityDelegation.description: References to verification methods used for capability delegation.

service.description: Service endpoints associated with this DID.

aicp:principal.description: The DID of the human or organization principal behind this agent.

aicp:delegationCredential.description: URI or identifier of the verifiable credential that grants this agent delegation authority.

created.description: Timestamp when this DID Document was created.

updated.description: Timestamp when this DID Document was last updated.

versionId.description: Monotonically increasing version number for this DID Document.

id.description: Unique identifier for this verification method, typically the DID with a fragment.

type.description: The cryptographic suite used by this verification method.

controller.description: The DID of the entity that controls this verification method.

publicKeyMultibase.description: The public key encoded in multibase format (base58-btc, prefixed with 'z').

id.description: Unique identifier for this service endpoint.

serviceEndpoint.description: The URI of the service endpoint.
